n_earth.note: Earth ground stations in the simulated network

n_sat.note: constellation satellites in the simulated network

observability.condition.note: condition number lambda_max / lambda_min of the Fisher information over the observable subspace, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.defect.note: datum-defect dimension n - rank, the number of unobservable directions; 0 means fully observable, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.e_opt.note: E-optimality lambda_min of the Fisher information matrix, the worst-observed direction; the state is stored in units of 1e6 m (clocks as range-equivalent metres) so the information is an inverse squared stored unit, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.n_params.note: state dimension n of the Fisher information matrix, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.rank.note: numerical rank of the Fisher information matrix, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.station_pos_crlb_m.note: Cramer-Rao lower bound on the station 3-D absolute-position error (1-sigma RSS of the three position variances, rescaled to metres); null when the station position lies inside the datum defect, for the configured network with VLBI

observability.station_pos_unobservable_a.note: effective number of the station's three position axes captured by the datum defect, sum over null-space basis vectors of the squared projection onto those axes; a generally fractional number in [0, 3] where 0 is fully observable, for the configured network with VLBI

observability_without_vlbi.condition.note: condition number lambda_max / lambda_min of the Fisher information over the observable subspace, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.defect.note: datum-defect dimension n - rank, the number of unobservable directions; 0 means fully observable, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.e_opt.note: E-optimality lambda_min of the Fisher information matrix, the worst-observed direction; the state is stored in units of 1e6 m (clocks as range-equivalent metres) so the information is an inverse squared stored unit, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.n_params.note: state dimension n of the Fisher information matrix, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.rank.note: numerical rank of the Fisher information matrix, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.station_pos_c.note: Cramer-Rao lower bound on the station 3-D absolute-position error (1-sigma RSS of the three position variances, rescaled to metres); null when the station position lies inside the datum defect, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

observability_without_vlbi.station_pos_u.note: effective number of the station's three position axes captured by the datum defect, sum over null-space basis vectors of the squared projection onto those axes; a generally fractional number in [0, 3] where 0 is fully observable, for the same network with the VLBI legs removed

station_observability_improvement_factor.note: without_vlbi.station_pos_err_m / with_vlbi.station_pos_err_m - how many times the Earth-baseline VLBI legs sharpen the station 3-D recovery

with_vlbi.iterations.note: Gauss-Newton iterations actually run before the step norm fell below tolerance (or the cap was hit), with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.n_obs.note: observables in the batch, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.n_params.note: estimated parameters: 3 station position + 3 per satellite + one clock per asset, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.rms_residual.note: unweighted RMS of the post-fit residual z - h(x) over the whole observation vector, which mixes the VLBI delays (s) with the clock-sync pseudo-observation and every range (m, clocks carried as range-equivalent metres); a diagnostic, not a single-unit quantity, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.sat_clock_rms_s.note: RMS over the constellation of the per-satellite clock-offset error, in seconds after the range-equivalent-metre state is divided by c, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.sat_pos_rms_m.note: RMS over the constellation of the per-satellite 3-D position error (recovered minus true), with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.station_clock_err_s.note: magnitude of the station clock-offset error; the clock state is estimated in range-equivalent metres and divided by c on the way out, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

with_vlbi.station_pos_err_m.note: magnitude of the recovered-minus-true lunar station 3-D position error, with the Earth-baseline VLBI legs included

without_vlbi.iterations.note: Gauss-Newton iterations actually run before the step norm fell below tolerance (or the cap was hit), with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.n_obs.note: observables in the batch, with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.n_params.note: estimated parameters: 3 station position + 3 per satellite + one clock per asset, with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.rms_residual.note: unweighted RMS of the post-fit residual z - h(x) over the whole observation vector, which mixes the VLBI delays (s) with the clock-sync pseudo-observation and every range (m, clocks carried as range-equivalent metres); a diagnostic, not a single-unit quantity, with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.sat_clock_rms_s.note: RMS over the constellation of the per-satellite clock-offset error, in seconds after the range-equivalent-metre state is divided by c, with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.sat_pos_rms_m.note: RMS over the constellation of the per-satellite 3-D position error (recovered minus true), with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.station_clock_err_s.note: magnitude of the station clock-offset error; the clock state is estimated in range-equivalent metres and divided by c on the way out, with lunar-local ranging only

without_vlbi.station_pos_err_m.note: magnitude of the recovered-minus-true lunar station 3-D position error, with lunar-local ranging only
